Name: Carpentry labour
Description: Licensed carpenter per hour

Description: 8 hours on site

Name: Minimum charge
Description: Covers travel and the first 2 hours on site

Name: Measure and quote visit
Description: Free within service area; charged only for out-of-area or design work

Description: Fit and hang one internal door into existing jamb; hinges and latch

Name: Install prehung door
Description: Remove old door and frame; install prehung door set; does not include painting

Name: Hang external door
Description: Hang solid external door; fit hinges and latch; weather seal

Name: Fit lockset or handle
Description: Fit handle or lockset to existing door

Name: Architraves per door
Description: Remove and replace architraves both sides of one door

Name: Skirting boards
Description: Remove and replace skirting; labour only

Description: Set out; footings; bearers and joists to AS 1684; labour only

Name: Deck boards (labour)
Description: Lay and fix boards; trim edges; labour only

Name: Re-board deck (labour)
Description: Remove old boards; check and repair frame; lay new boards; labour only

Name: Sand and oil deck
Description: Sand and two coats deck oil; includes oil

Name: Deck stairs per step
Description: Build stair stringers and treads; labour only

Name: Balustrade (labour)
Description: Timber posts; rails and balusters to code; labour only

Name: Pergola (labour)
Description: Freestanding or attached timber pergola frame; labour only

Name: Build and hang timber gate
Description: Gate frame; cladding; hinges and latch; labour only

Name: Fence repair
Description: Replace posts; rails or palings; hourly plus materials

Name: Built-in shelving
Description: Fit timber or melamine shelving; labour only

Name: Stud wall framing
Description: Frame new non-structural stud wall; labour only

Name: Materials (supplier cost + margin)
Description: Timber; fixings and hardware at supplier price plus 15% handling

Description: Remove and dispose of old materials and site waste

Name: Skip bin
Description: Hire of skip bin; price varies by size and council

Description: Extra work agreed in writing during the job
